title: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理模型技术报告
best_for_zh: 研究多模态 RL 与披露边界的读者
one_line: GLM-V discloses a broad multimodal pre-training, long-CoT SFT and GRPO/RLCS pipeline with domain-specific rewards, and releases weights plus reward/inference code while withholding the training records and curriculum ledger.
GLM-V 报告以 RLCS 扩展多模态推理，但样本与奖励来源仍未充分披露。
why: It is a useful disclosure-ledger case because model and verifier availability can be audited separately from unreleased multimodal sources, long-CoT traces, difficulty labels, rollouts and selection decisions.
inclusion_reason: A high-information multimodal frontier report that documents pre-training source categories, long-CoT SFT, multi-domain verifiers, RLHF/RLVR and adaptive RL curriculum sampling while releasing model weights and reward/inference code but not training records.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier multimodal reports combine several evidence types that are easy to conflate: aggregate descriptions of hidden training corpora, downloadable model weights, public inference or reward code, and benchmark results. GLM-V is useful for the disclosure ledger because its current technical report describes a broad pre-training, long-chain-of-thought SFT, RLHF/RLVR, and curriculum-sampled GRPO pipeline, while the official release exposes models and selected components rather than the underlying training records.

The relevant data objects change by stage. Pre-training records include image-caption pairs, interleaved pages and books, OCR renderings, grounding boxes, GUI screenshots and DOM-derived question-answer pairs, videos, documents, diagrams, and text. SFT records pair multimodal prompts with standardized long-CoT responses. RL records add task/subdomain, offline and online difficulty, one or more policy rollouts, extracted boxed answers, verifier or reward-model scores, format/style judgments, and selection for an update. The report describes these schemas conceptually but does not release a joined record ledger.

Official artifacts have a different boundary. GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking, GLM-4.1V-9B-Base, and GLM-4.5V weights are linked from the official repository; the two instruction-model Hugging Face cards are labeled MIT. The GitHub repository is Apache-2.0 and includes deployment examples plus a domain-specific reward system. No official pre-training corpus, long-CoT SFT set, RL prompt pool, difficulty labels, preference set, rollout log, accepted/rejected curriculum records, or full training infrastructure was confirmed. Open weights and verifier code therefore must not be recorded as an open training-data release.

前沿多模态报告往往同时包含几类容易混淆的证据：对隐藏训练语料的汇总描述、可下载模型权重、公开的推理或奖励代码，以及 benchmark 结果。GLM-V 对披露账本很有价值，因为当前技术报告详细描述了大规模预训练、长思维链 SFT、RLHF/RLVR 和带课程采样的 GRPO 流程，而官方发布开放的是模型与部分组件，不是底层训练记录。

不同阶段的数据对象并不相同。预训练记录包括图像描述对、图文交错网页与书籍、OCR 渲染、grounding 框、GUI 截图和 DOM 派生问答、视频、文档、图示和文本。SFT 记录把多模态提示与标准化长 CoT 回答配对。RL 记录还应包含任务/子域、离线与在线难度、一个或多个策略 rollout、抽取出的盒装答案、验证器或 reward model 分数、格式/风格判定，以及是否被选入更新。报告从概念上描述了这些 schema，但没有发布可跨阶段连接的记录账本。

官方产物的开放边界不同。官方仓库链接了 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking、GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 和 GLM-4.5V 权重；两个指令模型的 Hugging Face 卡均标为 MIT。GitHub 仓库采用 Apache-2.0，包含部署示例和领域化奖励系统。未确认官方预训练语料、长 CoT SFT 集、RL 提示池、难度标签、偏好集、rollout 日志、课程采样的接收/拒绝记录或完整训练基础设施。因此，开放权重与验证器代码不能被记为训练数据开放。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report treats multimodal reasoning as a staged data-and-feedback system. A shared vision encoder/adapter/decoder architecture is first trained on broad multimodal mixtures. A cleaned long-CoT SFT stage teaches explicit thinking and answer formatting. Multi-domain RL then combines Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for tasks with checkable outcomes and RLHF-style model rewards for open-ended or semantic tasks.

RLCS—Reinforcement Learning with Curriculum Sampling—is the central selection mechanism. Before RL, pass@k results from several established VLMs or earlier checkpoints are merged with expert human labels to assign difficulty tiers. During training, rollout pass@k and subcategory performance update the difficulty estimate. Sampling ratios are reweighted every iteration to reduce exposure to examples that are currently too easy or too hard and emphasize the mid-range where correct and incorrect attempts coexist.

A second selection layer, ratio-EMA sampling expansion, responds to all-correct or all-incorrect rollout groups that carry no useful GRPO gradient after KL and entropy losses are removed. The system estimates the recent invalid-sample rate, oversamples the next rollout batch, then retains a subset with a more balanced correct/incorrect composition. The report explains the mechanism but does not disclose its exact coefficients, rollout counts, selected examples, or per-iteration curriculum history.

The feedback contract is explicitly heterogeneous. Rule-based components extract special-token-delimited final answers and perform exact matching; mathematics uses SymPy and tolerances; OCR uses edit distance; grounding uses IoU; GUI tasks mix action prediction, IoU, functional and semantic checks; charts, documents, VQA, spatial tasks and video may fall back to LLM judgment. Format and style rewards address box usage, language mixing, repetition, fluency, and instruction compliance. These are primarily final-output or scalar signals, not verified step-by-step reasoning labels.

报告把多模态推理视为分阶段的数据与反馈系统。共享的视觉编码器/adapter/decoder 架构先在广泛多模态混合数据上训练；经过清洗的长 CoT SFT 阶段教授显式思考与答案格式；多领域 RL 随后把适用于可检查任务的 Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards（RLVR）与适用于开放或语义任务的 RLHF 式模型奖励结合。

RLCS（Reinforcement Learning with Curriculum Sampling）是核心选择机制。RL 开始前，系统把多个已有 VLM 或早期检查点的 pass@k 结果与专家人工标签合并，分配难度层级。训练中，rollout 的 pass@k 和子类表现继续更新难度估计。采样比例每个训练 iteration 都会重加权：减少当前过易或过难样本，提高同时存在正确与错误尝试的中等难度区域。

第二层选择机制是基于 ratio EMA 的动态采样扩展。去掉 KL 和 entropy loss 后，全对或全错的 rollout 组对 GRPO 不产生有效梯度。系统根据最近的无效样本率估计下一批 oversampling 比例，再从扩展 rollout 中保留正确/错误更均衡的子集。报告解释了机制，但没有披露准确系数、rollout 数量、选中样本或逐 iteration 课程历史。

反馈契约明确是异构的。规则组件抽取由特殊 token 标记的最终答案并做精确匹配；数学使用 SymPy 和容差；OCR 使用编辑距离；grounding 使用 IoU；GUI 任务混合动作预测、IoU、功能和语义检查；图表、文档、VQA、空间任务与视频可能回退到 LLM 判断。格式与风格奖励检查盒标记、语言混杂、重复、流畅度和指令遵循。这些主要是最终输出或标量信号，不是经验证的逐步推理标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Pre-training source pools. The report starts from more than 10B image-text pairs drawn from LAION, DataComp, DFN, Wukong, and web search, and also names MINT, MMC4, OmniCorpus, more than 100M digitized books, academic papers, synthetic and natural OCR, grounding, GUI, video, and text sources. These are source or initial-pool quantities, not a released final-record manifest.
  1. Source-specific construction and filtering. Image-caption data undergo resolution, solid-color, caption-length and image deduplication rules, CLIP filtering above 0.3, concept-balanced resampling, and factual recaptioning. Interleaved web data removes irrelevant images, advertisements, QR codes, and low-information layouts. Academic PDFs are parsed; OCR pages and tables are rendered; GLIPv2 supplies natural-image boxes; Playwright captures GUI screenshots and visible DOM elements; video uses integrity checks, embedding deduplication, and human-in-the-loop annotation.
  1. Reported pre-training products. The report names 220M OCR images, 40M natural-image grounding annotations, more than 140M GUI question-answer pairs, and a 50M instruction-tuning mixture, plus video and interleaved corpora without complete final counts. It describes manual and automated contamination review for open-source instruction data. It does not publish the final unique-record count, per-source weights, source revisions, licenses, filtering yields, or train/evaluation overlap ledger.
  1. Pre-training schedule. GLM-4.1V-Thinking and GLM-4.5V use the shared AIMv2-Huge-based vision architecture with GLM-4-9B-0414 and GLM-4.5-Air respectively. Multimodal pre-training runs for 120,000 steps at sequence length 8,192 and global batch 1,536; long-context continuation adds video and sequences beyond 8K, running 10,000 steps at length 32,768 and the same batch. Packing and model-specific tensor/expert/pipeline/context parallelism are described.
  1. Long-CoT SFT. Curate Chinese- and English-dominant reasoning examples across verifiable and non-verifiable domains. The pretrained model filters prompts judged too easy or too hard. Responses use a think span and answer span, with exactly one region delimited by the begin_of_box and end_of_box special tokens for verifiable answers; GLM-4.5V omits explicit answer tags. Remove format violations, inconsistent/noisy reasoning, mixed-language phrasing, and redundant thoughts, and recycle selected examples from later RL checkpoints. Full-parameter SFT uses length 32,768 and global batch 32; record count and generator lineage are unknown.
  1. RL task preparation. Identify verifiable sub-tasks in every domain, filter or synthesize question-answer pairs, convert unique-answer multiple choice into fill-in-the-blank, validate correctness, and assign offline difficulty from multi-model pass@k plus expert labels. Pilot RL runs test whether each domain's data and reward design produce learnable gains. Counts, source snapshots, pilot outcomes, and retained manifests are not released.
  1. Reward construction. Extract the boxed answer for RLVR and apply task-specific rule, symbolic, geometric, functional, or semantic checks; use reward models for RLHF tasks. Shared format/style checks penalize invalid box use, mixed languages, repetition, poor fluency, or instruction noncompliance. The official repository releases a configurable VLM reward-system package with symbolic, multimodal, and agent verifiers, including LLM-judge fallbacks, but not the reward-model checkpoint or full production reward logs.
  1. RLCS and GRPO. Blend domains in predetermined but undisclosed proportions and optimize with GRPO. Combine offline tiers with online rollout pass@k and subcategory performance, reweighting difficulty every iteration. Ratio-EMA expands sampling to offset all-correct/all-incorrect groups. Other reported choices include larger batches, forced answering after truncation, removal of KL and entropy losses, a higher upper clip, top-p 1, per-sample loss, load balancing, packing, and gradient accumulation. Exact rollouts, temperature, batch, learning rate, clip, steps, tokens, and compute remain unknown.

1. 预训练来源池。 报告从超过 100 亿图像—文本对开始，来源包括 LAION、DataComp、DFN、Wukong 和 Web 搜索；还列出 MINT、MMC4、OmniCorpus、超过 1 亿本数字化书籍、学术论文、合成与自然 OCR、grounding、GUI、视频和文本来源。这些是来源或初始池规模，不是已发布的最终记录清单。
  1. 按来源构造与过滤。 图像描述数据经过分辨率、纯色、描述长度、图像去重规则，CLIP 分数阈值高于 0.3，再做概念均衡重采样和事实中心 recaption。图文交错 Web 数据删除无关图片、广告、二维码和低信息布局。学术 PDF 被解析，OCR 页面与表格被渲染，GLIPv2 生成自然图像框，Playwright 捕获 GUI 截图和可见 DOM 元素，视频则经过完整性检查、embedding 去重和 human-in-the-loop 标注。
  1. 报告的预训练产物。 报告列出 2.2 亿 OCR 图像、4,000 万自然图像 grounding 标注、超过 1.4 亿 GUI 问答和 5,000 万 instruction-tuning 混合样本；视频和图文交错语料没有完整最终数量。报告称对开源 instruction 数据进行人工与自动污染检查，但没有发布最终唯一记录数、各来源权重、来源版本、许可证、过滤产出率或训练—评测重叠账本。
  1. 预训练日程。 GLM-4.1V-Thinking 与 GLM-4.5V 使用共享的 AIMv2-Huge 视觉架构，并分别接入 GLM-4-9B-0414 和 GLM-4.5-Air。多模态预训练在序列长度 8,192、全局 batch 1,536 下运行 120,000 步；长上下文继续训练加入视频和超过 8K 的序列，在长度 32,768 和同一 batch 下运行 10,000 步。报告还描述打包和各模型对应的 tensor/expert/pipeline/context 并行。
  1. 长 CoT SFT。 在可验证与不可验证领域整理以中文、英文为主的推理样本，用预训练模型过滤过易或过难的提示。回答使用 think 区和 answer 区；可验证答案必须只有一个由 begin_of_box 和 end_of_box 特殊 token 标记的区域；GLM-4.5V 去掉显式 answer 标签。流程删除格式错误、不一致或噪声推理、语言混杂和冗余思考，并把后续 RL 检查点中的选中样本回流。全参数 SFT 使用长度 32,768、全局 batch 32；记录数量与生成器谱系未知。
  1. RL 任务准备。 在每个领域识别可验证子任务，过滤或合成问答，把唯一答案选择题改成填空，验证正确性，再把多模型 pass@k 与专家标签结合为离线难度。各领域先运行 pilot RL，确认数据与奖励是否能产生可学习增益。数量、来源快照、试验结果和保留清单均未发布。
  1. 奖励构造。 RLVR 抽取盒装答案后执行领域化规则、符号、几何、功能或语义检查；RLHF 任务使用 reward model。共享格式/风格检查会惩罚错误盒标记、语言混杂、重复、流畅度不足或不遵循指令。官方仓库公开了可配置 VLM 奖励系统包，包含符号、多模态和 agent 验证器及 LLM-judge fallback，但未开放 reward-model 检查点或完整生产奖励日志。
  1. RLCS 与 GRPO。 以预设但未披露的比例混合领域数据，用 GRPO 优化。离线难度层级与在线 rollout pass@k、子类表现结合，每个 iteration 重加权。ratio-EMA 扩展采样以弥补全对/全错组。其他报告选择包括更大 batch、截断后强制回答、移除 KL 和 entropy loss、提高上 clip、top-p 设为 1、per-sample loss、负载均衡、打包和梯度累积。准确 rollout 数、温度、batch、学习率、clip、步数、tokens 与计算量仍未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The report provides unusually concrete construction evidence for a frontier VLM: named source families, initial-pool or annotation counts, filtering rules, response tags, difficulty-label sources, domain-specific reward logic, and several training schedules. Examples include the >10B image-text initial pool, 220M OCR images, 40M natural-image grounding annotations, >140M GUI QA pairs, a 50M instruction mixture, 120K pre-training steps, and 10K long-context steps. These quantities describe different stages and cannot be added into one final released dataset size.

The feedback evidence is also specific. The report documents reward hacking when weak LLM judges accepted vague ranges or approximate descriptions, and shows that a weak verifier in one multimodal subdomain can raise reward while degrading both that task and unrelated STEM benchmarks. This motivates box-token extraction, domain-specific verifier logic, unit tests, and format/style rewards. It supports the claim that reward design mattered to the reported training; it does not provide false-accept rates or prove that the final verifier suite is calibrated.

Across 42 public benchmarks, the current report compares the 9B GLM-4.1V model and 106B-total/12B-active GLM-4.5V with other open and closed systems. Illustrative reported changes from GLM-4.1V to GLM-4.5V include MMMU Pro 57.1 to 65.2, MathVista 80.7 to 84.6, ChartQAPro 59.5 to 64.0, OSWorld 14.9 to 35.8, AndroidWorld 41.7 to 57.0, and Design2Code 64.7 to 82.2. The report also states that RL experiments on GLM-4.5V produce gains up to 10.6 percentage points. These are model-evaluation results, not direct measurements of corpus quality, licensing, or contamination.

The cross-domain experiment starts from the GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking SFT checkpoint and compares STEM, OCR & Chart, Grounding, GUI Agent, and mix-all RL data. Single-domain training often improves other domains; mix-all is best in three of five evaluated groups, but not grounding or GUI agents. This supports heterogeneous transfer while preserving a counterexample to universal synergy. Exact training sample counts and the per-domain curriculum records are still absent.

Artifact evidence must be recorded separately. Official Hugging Face cards expose GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking safetensor weights under MIT, and the repository links the GLM-4.1V-9B-Base weights. The Apache-2.0 GitHub repository contains inference, examples, integrations, and the released glmv_reward package with a lockfile and tests. It does not expose the pre-training/SFT/RL datasets, complete model-training or GRPO infrastructure, curriculum sampler state, policy rollouts, human preferences, production reward logs, or reward-model weights.

这份报告对前沿 VLM 给出了较具体的构造证据：命名的来源类别、初始池或标注数量、过滤规则、回答标签、难度标签来源、领域奖励逻辑和若干训练日程。例如，超过 100 亿图文初始池、2.2 亿 OCR 图像、4,000 万自然图像 grounding 标注、超过 1.4 亿 GUI 问答、5,000 万 instruction 混合样本、12 万预训练步和 1 万长上下文步。这些数字属于不同阶段，不能相加成一个最终发布数据集规模。

反馈证据也较具体。报告记录了弱 LLM judge 接受模糊范围或近似描述所导致的 reward hacking，并展示某个多模态子域的弱验证器会在奖励上升时同时损害本任务与无关 STEM benchmark。这支持使用盒 token 抽取、领域验证逻辑、单元测试和格式/风格奖励，也说明奖励设计影响报告中的训练；但它没有给出误接受率，不能证明最终验证器套件已经校准。

当前报告在 42 个公开 benchmark 上比较 9B GLM-4.1V、总参数 106B/激活 12B 的 GLM-4.5V 与其他开放和闭源系统。GLM-4.1V 到 GLM-4.5V 的示例变化包括：MMMU Pro 57.1 到 65.2、MathVista 80.7 到 84.6、ChartQAPro 59.5 到 64.0、OSWorld 14.9 到 35.8、AndroidWorld 41.7 到 57.0、Design2Code 64.7 到 82.2。报告还称 GLM-4.5V 的 RL 实验最高提升 10.6 个百分点。这些是模型评测结果，不是语料质量、许可或污染的直接测量。

跨领域实验从 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking 的 SFT 检查点开始，比较 STEM、OCR & Chart、Grounding、GUI Agent 和 mix-all RL 数据。单领域训练常会提升其他领域；mix-all 在五类中的三类最好，但并未改善 grounding 或 GUI agent。这支持异构任务间存在迁移，也保留了“并非所有领域都协同”的反例。准确训练样本数和逐领域课程记录仍缺失。

产物证据必须单独记录。官方 Hugging Face 卡以 MIT 提供 GLM-4.5V 和 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking safetensor 权重，仓库还链接 GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 权重。Apache-2.0 GitHub 仓库包含推理、示例、集成和带 lockfile、测试的 glmv_reward 包。它没有开放预训练/SFT/RL 数据、完整模型训练或 GRPO 基础设施、课程采样器状态、策略 rollouts、人工偏好、生产奖励日志或 reward-model 权重。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For reasoning-data curation, the strongest contribution is the disclosure of one unified but domain-dependent feedback layer. Instead of pretending that all multimodal tasks share one verifier, the report distinguishes symbolic tolerance, edit distance, IoU, action/function checks, exact matching, semantic judges, reward models, and format/style signals. It also documents the operational danger: a single weak reward channel can destabilize joint training.

RLCS adds a dynamic data-selection view. The curriculum is not a fixed easy-to-hard ordering; it combines offline multi-model pass@k and expert labels with online rollout outcomes and subcategory performance, then changes sampling ratios at training-iteration granularity. Ratio-EMA sampling expansion further treats all-correct and all-incorrect rollout groups as unusable gradient regions and adjusts data generation accordingly.

The ingredients are not individually new: large-scale multimodal pre-training, long-CoT SFT, GRPO, RLVR, RLHF, curriculum learning, online difficulty estimates, domain verifiers, and rejection based on reward have prior art. The novelty is the engineering composition across vision-language domains, along with the report's failure analyses and the combination of thinking/non-thinking behavior in GLM-4.5V.

The work is not a released reasoning-data recipe in the strong sense. The report tells readers what kinds of records and selection signals exist, and the reward package implements many checking functions, but the prompts, records, difficulty labels, rollout groups, curriculum weights, accepted updates, and stage-wise lineage are not public. This is therefore a frontier disclosure report and partial construction recipe, not an open data corpus.

The current arXiv report has expanded beyond the original GLM-4.1V release to cover GLM-4.5V and later GLM-4.6V results. Model cards retain release-specific figures and templates. Audits should pin the report, repository, and each model revision rather than assume all versions share identical data, conversation format, context length, or evaluation tables.

对推理数据策展而言，最重要的贡献是披露了统一但依领域变化的反馈层。报告没有假定所有多模态任务共享一个验证器，而是区分符号容差、编辑距离、IoU、动作/功能检查、精确匹配、语义 judge、reward model 和格式/风格信号；它还记录了实际风险：一个薄弱奖励通道就可能使联合训练不稳定。

RLCS 提供动态数据选择视角。课程并不是固定的由易到难排序，而是把离线多模型 pass@k 和专家标签与在线 rollout 结果、子类表现结合，再在训练 iteration 粒度改变采样比例。ratio-EMA 采样扩展还把全对与全错 rollout 组视为无有效梯度区域，并据此调整数据生成量。

其中各个要素并非分别首次出现：大规模多模态预训练、长 CoT SFT、GRPO、RLVR、RLHF、课程学习、在线难度估计、领域验证器和基于奖励的筛选都有先例。新意在于跨视觉语言领域的工程组合、对失败模式的报告，以及 GLM-4.5V 中 thinking/non-thinking 行为的联合训练。

该工作并不是强意义上的开放推理数据配方。报告说明了有哪些记录与选择信号，奖励包也实现了多种检查函数，但提示、记录、难度标签、rollout 组、课程权重、接收更新与逐阶段谱系并未公开。因此它是前沿披露报告与部分构造配方，而不是开放数据语料。

当前 arXiv 报告已从最初 GLM-4.1V 发布扩展到 GLM-4.5V，之后又纳入 GLM-4.6V 结果；模型卡仍保留各发布版本的数字和模板。审计应固定报告、仓库和每个模型 revision，不能假定所有版本使用完全相同的数据、对话格式、上下文长度或评测表。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No record-level corpus: source families and large counts are disclosed, but final unique examples, mixture weights, immutable snapshots, filtering yields, stage splits, and source-to-record mappings are not.
  • Rights remain stage-specific: Apache-2.0 covers repository code and MIT labels the released weights; neither licenses the hidden public/web/proprietary/human/synthetic training mixtures or generated traces.
  • SFT lineage is missing: the size, generators, prompts, checker identities, per-domain composition, easy/hard thresholds, and RL-checkpoint-to-record mapping of the long-CoT corpus are unknown.
  • Curriculum is not reproducible: domain proportions, pass@k values and k, human-label protocol, difficulty bins, iteration weights, ratio-EMA coefficients, selected rollout groups, and random seeds are not published.
  • Outcome reward can reinforce bad reasoning: the report explicitly observes correct answers reached through incorrect steps; most released verifier logic evaluates final outputs rather than process faithfulness.
  • Model-judge coverage is uncertain: LLM and reward-model identities, prompts, calibration, judge disagreement, false accepts/rejects, and model-based semantic thresholds are not reported.
  • Reward hacking and cross-domain collapse remain risks: vague answers can fool weak judges, and a faulty verifier in one domain can degrade unrelated capabilities during mixed training.
  • Decontamination is not auditable: the report mentions manual/automated review and modality deduplication but provides no benchmark signatures, thresholds, removal counts, or corpus-wide overlap report.
  • Training budget is incomplete: pre-training/SFT schedules are reported, but RL rollouts, batch, learning rate, clipping values, total steps, tokens, compute, reward-model cost, and infrastructure implementation are missing.
  • Model limitations persist: the report cites incorrect reasoning, RL sensitivity, clutter/occlusion/ambiguity failures, and guesswork; the repository additionally lists overthinking, repetition, answer restatement, counting/person-identification, and pure-text weaknesses.

• 没有逐记录语料： 报告披露来源类别和大规模数字，但没有最终唯一样本数、混合权重、不可变快照、过滤产出率、阶段切分或来源到记录映射。
  • 权利边界按阶段分离： Apache-2.0 覆盖仓库代码，MIT 标注发布权重；两者都不许可隐藏的公开/Web/专有/人工/合成训练混合数据或生成轨迹。
  • SFT 谱系缺失： 长 CoT 语料的规模、生成器、提示、检查器身份、各领域构成、难易阈值和 RL 检查点到记录的映射均未知。
  • 课程无法复现： 领域比例、pass@k 数值与 k、人工标注协议、难度桶、逐 iteration 权重、ratio-EMA 系数、选中 rollout 组和随机种子没有公开。
  • 结果奖励可能强化错误推理： 报告明确观察到答案正确但步骤错误；大多数公开验证逻辑检查最终输出，而不是过程忠实性。
  • 模型 judge 覆盖不确定： LLM 与 reward-model 身份、提示、校准、judge 分歧、误接受/误拒绝和模型语义阈值均未报告。
  • Reward hacking 与跨域崩溃仍是风险： 模糊回答可能骗过弱 judge，一个领域中的错误验证器也可能在混合训练中损害无关能力。
  • 去污染不可审计： 报告提到人工/自动检查和模态去重，但没有 benchmark 签名、阈值、删除数量或全语料重叠报告。
  • 训练预算不完整： 预训练/SFT 日程已报告，但 RL rollout、batch、学习率、clip 数值、总步数、tokens、计算量、reward-model 成本和基础设施实现缺失。
  • 模型局限仍存在： 报告列出错误推理、RL 敏感性、杂乱/遮挡/歧义图像失败和猜测；仓库还列出过度思考、重复、重复答案、计数/人物识别和纯文本能力问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger track, GLM-V is a strong example of why openness must be recorded by artifact class. A ledger should have separate rows for report disclosure, GLM-4.1V-9B-Base weights, GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking weights, GLM-4.5V weights, inference/preprocessing code, reward-system code, reward-model weights, training infrastructure, and every data stage. Only the first six are confirmed in some public form; the training records and full optimizer stack are not.

A reproducible data ledger should assign stable IDs to each multimodal asset, prompt, response, generator/checkpoint, source/license record, deduplication cluster, offline difficulty label, human label, rollout group, boxed extraction, rule-verifier result, LLM-judge request/response, style reward, curriculum weight, selection decision, policy version, and final update. Store rejected as well as accepted records, with hashes and reason codes.

The report also offers practical design hypotheses to test independently: use source-specific filtering instead of one generic quality score; teach parseable answer formats before RL; separate semantic equivalence from exact OCR matching; unit-test each domain verifier; monitor cross-domain metrics for reward collapse; update difficulty online; and oversample before selecting informative mixed-outcome rollout groups. None should be treated as universally valid without ablations and failure logs.

For model reuse, pin each Hugging Face revision and repository commit, preserve the correct conversation template for GLM-4.1V versus GLM-4.5V, audit the MIT weight and Apache-2.0 code terms independently, and reproduce benchmark prompts and inference settings before comparing scores. Model cards are deployment evidence, not training-corpus documentation.

For future disclosure, publish final per-domain counts and mixture weights; source and rights manifests; SFT and RL record schemas; difficulty-label distributions; rollout and selection totals; reward-model/checker versions; verifier tests and error rates; RL hyperparameters and compute; contamination signatures and removals; and a record-level lineage connecting each released checkpoint to its data and feedback revisions.

对 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 赛道，GLM-V 很好地说明开放性必须按产物类别分别记录。账本应为报告披露、GLM-4.1V-9B-Base 权重、GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking 权重、GLM-4.5V 权重、推理/预处理代码、奖励系统代码、reward-model 权重、训练基础设施和每个数据阶段分别设行。目前只有前六类以某种公开形式得到确认；训练记录和完整优化栈没有公开。

可复现数据账本应为每个多模态资产、提示、回答、生成器/检查点、来源/许可记录、去重簇、离线难度、人工标签、rollout 组、盒内容抽取、规则验证结果、LLM-judge 请求/响应、风格奖励、课程权重、选择决策、策略版本和最终更新分配稳定 ID。接收与拒绝记录都应保留，并带哈希与原因码。

报告还给出可独立检验的数据设计假设：按来源过滤而不是使用单一通用质量分；在 RL 前教会可解析答案格式；区分语义等价与 OCR 精确匹配；对每个领域验证器做单元测试；监测跨领域指标以发现奖励崩溃；在线更新难度；先 oversample 再选择结果混合、信息量更高的 rollout 组。没有消融和失败日志时，这些都不能被视为普适结论。

复用模型时，应固定每个 Hugging Face revision 和仓库 commit，保留 GLM-4.1V 与 GLM-4.5V 各自正确的对话模板，独立审计 MIT 权重条款和 Apache-2.0 代码条款，并在比较分数前复现 benchmark 提示和推理设置。模型卡是部署证据，不是训练语料文档。

未来披露应发布最终各领域数量与混合权重、来源和权利清单、SFT/RL 记录 schema、难度分布、rollout 与选择总数、reward-model/检查器版本、验证器测试与错误率、RL 超参数与计算量、污染签名与删除结果，以及把每个发布检查点连接到数据和反馈 revision 的逐记录谱系。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read quantities by stage: >10B image-text pairs is an initial pool, while 220M OCR images, 40M grounding annotations, >140M GUI QA pairs, and 50M instruction samples describe different constructed subsets.
  • Long-CoT SFT has explicit think/answer/box formatting and cleaning rules, but no public record count, generator manifest, or trace release.
  • RLCS combines offline multi-model pass@k plus expert labels with online rollout outcomes; exact domain ratios, bins, k, and curriculum histories are missing.
  • The reward system is domain-specific and partly open-sourced, yet most signals validate final outputs; the report itself warns that correct answers can contain wrong reasoning.
  • Benchmark improvements and cross-domain transfer are model-utility evidence, not proof that hidden data are licensed, uncontaminated, or reproducible.
  • Keep release classes separate: MIT model weights and Apache-2.0 reward/inference code are public; training corpora, long-CoT/RL records, reward-model weights, full training code, and lineage ledgers are not.

• 按阶段阅读规模：超过 100 亿图文对是初始池，2.2 亿 OCR 图像、4,000 万 grounding 标注、超过 1.4 亿 GUI 问答和 5,000 万 instruction 样本属于不同构造子集。
  • 长 CoT SFT 有明确 think/answer/box 格式和清洗规则，但没有公开记录数量、生成器清单或轨迹发布。
  • RLCS 把离线多模型 pass@k 与专家标签、在线 rollout 结果结合；准确领域比例、难度桶、k 和课程历史缺失。
  • 奖励系统按领域设计且部分开源，但多数信号验证最终输出；报告自己警告正确答案可能包含错误推理。
  • Benchmark 提升与跨域迁移是模型用途证据，不能证明隐藏数据已获许可、无污染或可复现。
  • 严格区分发布类别：MIT 模型权重和 Apache-2.0 奖励/推理代码已公开；训练语料、长 CoT/RL 记录、reward-model 权重、完整训练代码和谱系账本未公开。

title: Citation
引用
html:
``bibtex @misc{vteam2025glm45vglm41vthinkingversatilemultimodal, title = {GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning}, author = {GLM-V Team}, year = {2025}, eprint = {2507.01006}, archivePrefix = {arXiv}, primaryClass = {cs.CV}, url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01006} } ``

Official artifacts: technical report, official arXiv BibTeX, GLM-V repository and reward system, GLM-4.5V model card, and GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking model card. Pin revisions because the report and repository now also cover later GLM-V releases.

``bibtex @misc{vteam2025glm45vglm41vthinkingversatilemultimodal, title = {GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning}, author = {GLM-V Team}, year = {2025}, eprint = {2507.01006}, archivePrefix = {arXiv}, primaryClass = {cs.CV}, url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01006} } ``

官方产物：技术报告、arXiv 官方 BibTeX、GLM-V 仓库与奖励系统、GLM-4.5V 模型卡和 GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking 模型卡。报告与仓库现在还覆盖后续 GLM-V 发布，因此复用时应固定 revision。

value.html: Pre-training is described by source and capability categories rather than a record manifest: an initial pool of more than 10B image-text pairs from LAION, DataComp, DFN, Wukong and web search; MINT, MMC4 and OmniCorpus web interleaving; more than 100M digitized books; 220M OCR images; 40M natural-image grounding annotations; more than 140M GUI question-answer pairs; and academic, web, proprietary and human-annotated video. The report also names a 50M instruction-tuning mixture. SFT and RL prompts span verifiable and open-ended multimodal domains, but their counts, immutable snapshots and record-level sources are not released.

Long-CoT SFT uses a think span followed by an answer span. Verifiable final answers are enclosed by the special tokens <|begin_of_box|> and <|end_of_box|> for deterministic extraction; GLM-4.5V removes the explicit answer-tag tokens. GLM-4.5V also mixes thinking and /nothink examples.

The report names human annotation, factual recaptioning, synthetic rendering, pretrained vision/OCR/grounding tools, the pretrained GLM-V model, prior RL checkpoints, expert difficulty labels and model-based judges across stages. Exact generator and checkpoint assignments for each long-CoT SFT response or RL record are unknown.

Multi-domain RL combines exact and symbolic answer checks, tolerance checks, edit distance, IoU and action matching, functional evaluation, LLM judges, and reward models across STEM, OCR, charts, long documents, grounding, GUI agents, video and general VQA. The official repository releases an Apache-2.0 VLM reward-system implementation, not the complete in-house RL infrastructure or training data.

RLVR extracts boxed final answers and applies domain-specific rule, symbolic or functional verification; RLHF scores answer segments with reward models or model judges. Shared checks include format validation, box extraction and exact matching. Domain modules include SymPy with tolerance, edit distance, IoU, action matching, semantic judges and style/format rewards. These signals chiefly evaluate final outputs rather than every reasoning step.

Task dependent: exact or SymPy/tolerance answer agreement, edit-distance similarity, bounding-box IoU, action-plus-IoU or functional success, exact/semantic equivalence, or a model/reward score for open-ended tasks. The report does not define one universal terminal predicate or publish per-record verifier decisions.

GLM-4.1V-Thinking combines AIMv2-Huge vision initialization with GLM-4-9B-0414 and is released as GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking plus GLM-4.1V-9B-Base. GLM-4.5V combines the shared vision-language architecture with GLM-4.5-Air, a 106B-total, 12B-activated MoE.

The pretrained GLM-V model filters SFT difficulty; established VLMs and earlier RL checkpoints provide pass@k difficulty estimates; expert humans add difficulty labels; domain-specific LLM judges and reward models score non-verifiable or semantically matched answers. Exact teacher model IDs, prompts and checkpoint revisions are not fully disclosed.

Construction uses factual recaptioning, CLIP filtering, high-knowledge-density classifiers, PDF/LaTeXML parsing, PaddleOCR, GLIPv2 grounding, Playwright GUI capture, synthetic rendering and human-in-the-loop video annotation. Long-CoT response generators and synthetic RL question generators are not enumerated record by record.

RLCS blends domains in predetermined but undisclosed proportions. Offline pass@k from several models/checkpoints plus expert labels assigns difficulty tiers; online rollout pass@k and subcategory performance update those tiers and reweight sampling every training iteration, down-weighting very easy and very hard samples. Ratio-EMA expansion oversamples rollouts and selects subsets with more balanced correct/incorrect outcomes.
unknown
Rollout top-p is reported as 1 for stability; temperature and per-prompt rollout count are not disclosed.

Pre-training applies resolution, solid-color, caption-length, deduplication, CLIP-score (>0.3), concept balancing, source-specific cleaning and video integrity/embedding-deduplication filters. SFT removes very easy or very hard prompts, format violations, noisy or inconsistent reasoning, mixed-language phrasing and redundant thought patterns. RL preparation retains tasks that can be verified precisely, converts unique-answer multiple choice to fill-in-the-blank, checks correctness, grades difficulty and runs pilot RL experiments.

Multimodal pre-training uses length 8,192, global batch 1,536 and 120,000 steps; long-context continual training uses length 32,768, batch 1,536 and 10,000 steps. SFT uses length 32,768 and global batch 32. RL rollout lengths, total rollouts, iterations, tokens and compute are not reported.

Full-parameter SFT precedes multi-domain GRPO. Reported RL choices include RLCS, large batches, ratio-EMA sampling expansion, forced answering by inserting a closing think token at truncation, removal of KL and entropy losses, a higher upper importance-ratio clip, top-p=1 rollouts, per-sample loss, sequence/load balancing and packing. Exact learning rates, batch sizes, clipping values, step counts and full infrastructure code are undisclosed.

The report gives many source families, initial-pool or annotation counts and construction filters, but no immutable final mixture table, retained unique-record counts, per-source weights, source revisions, license map, filtering yields or released data manifest. Initial-pool counts such as more than 10B image-text pairs are not final training-set counts.
unknown

The report says all open-source instruction-tuning datasets undergo manual and automated contamination review and describes image/video deduplication. It does not publish benchmark signatures, thresholds, removal counts, corpus-wide overlap results or a reproducible train-evaluation ledger.

items: Final-output rewards can reinforce incorrect or hallucinated intermediate reasoning when the terminal answer passes; the report explicitly identifies this limitation.
Weak or hackable verifiers in one multimodal domain can destabilize or collapse joint training across domains.
LLM judges and semantic reward models have undisclosed versions, prompts, calibration and failure rates.
RLCS difficulty labels and domain proportions are not released, so the curriculum and selected rollout distribution cannot be reconstructed.
Pool and annotation counts are not final unique training counts, and source-level rights, mixture weights, filtering yields and split lineage remain unavailable.
Benchmark gains measure model behavior, not training-data quality, rights compliance, decontamination completeness or reproducibility.
The model repository lists remaining overthinking, repetition, answer restatement, counting/person-identification and pure-text weaknesses.

Open weights and reward/inference code do not imply release of pre-training data, SFT traces, RL prompts, rollout logs, human preferences, reward-model checkpoints or the full optimizer infrastructure.

value.html: The GLM-V GitHub repository is Apache-2.0. The official Hugging Face cards label GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking weights MIT. These licenses do not establish rights or redistribution terms for the unreleased pre-training, SFT, preference, RL curriculum or rollout data, whose sources include public, web, proprietary, synthetic and human-annotated material.

Heterogeneous multimodal sources -> source-specific filtering, recaptioning, parsing, rendering, annotation and balancing -> 120K-step multimodal pre-training -> 10K-step long-context continuation -> cleaned long-CoT SFT with thinking/non-thinking formatting -> RL task identification, verification-focused curation, offline and online difficulty grading -> multi-domain GRPO with RLCS and task-specific rewards -> released GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking/Base and GLM-4.5V weights plus inference and reward-system code. No record-level lineage joins these stages.
verified
medium

The current official arXiv report, official GLM-V GitHub repository and reward-system documentation, and official GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking Hugging Face model cards were checked on 2026-07-19. Training-stage disclosure is substantial, while record-level data and full training reproduction remain unavailable.

Official report, GLM-V code/reward repository, and both official weight model cards verified; no official training-dataset release or complete training implementation was confirmed.
